findings.finding: The initial compact icon padding could produce less than a 44 px touch target, while the default count badge could read generic bright red and did not communicate selection count accessibly.
findings.evidence: Commit 29e1993 adds explicit 44 by 44 targets, dark walnut/brass count chip, count-aware semantic label, assertions, and the refreshed narrow selected render.
